error.no_devices_found: Connected to the gateway, but it did not report any air conditioners.

data_description.gateway_address: The address the gateway itself answers to, which is 1 from the factory. Change this only if the gateway was set to another address.
data_description.host: The hostname or IP address of the ZhongHong gateway on your network.
data_description.port: The port the gateway accepts connections on. This is 9999 unless it was changed on the gateway.

cannot_connect.message: Failed to connect to the ZhongHong gateway at {host}.

no_devices_found.message: The ZhongHong gateway at {host} did not report any air conditioners.

send_command_failed.message: Failed to send {command} command to the ZhongHong gateway.

deprecated_yaml_import_issue_cannot_conn.description:
Configuring {integration_title} using YAML is being removed, but the gateway at {host} could not be reached, so the configuration could not be imported.

Check that the gateway is switched on and reachable at that address, then restart Home Assistant. If it is gone for good, remove the {domain} YAML configuration from your configuration.yaml file.
deprecated_yaml_import_issue_cannot_conn.title: The {integration_title} YAML configuration could not be imported

deprecated_yaml_import_issue_no_devices_.description:
Configuring {integration_title} using YAML is being removed, but the gateway at {host} did not report any air conditioners, so the configuration could not be imported.

Check that the air conditioners are switched on and addressed on the gateway, then restart Home Assistant.
deprecated_yaml_import_issue_no_devices_.title: [%key:component::zhong_hong::issues::deprecated_yaml_import_issue_cannot_connect::title%]
